field_semantics.build_rule: Tier tables supply species/identity only. Every rematch battle party is built at battle time by the difficulty layer (PUWDifficultyLayer.build_party_from_identity, delegating to PUWTeamBuilder): exactly 6, IV 31 in every stat, EV spread = the species' best sourced set under the 510 cap, level = player max, sets re-sourced on evolution. Pokemon and Moemon parties identically (23:15 CST parity ruling).
field_semantics.party[].iv: PROVENANCE-ONLY - the source game's recorded IV value (FRLG 0-255 scale; fixture ladder 0 -> 20 -> 60 -> 120); identity-history, NEVER a build value, never reaches a battle
field_semantics.party[].level: PROVENANCE-ONLY - the source game's recorded level for that tier; identity-history, NEVER a build value, never reaches a battle
field_semantics.party[].species: IDENTITY - the only battle-facing field; the build input (PM ruling D4, 2026-11-23)
